items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment. Reject new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, and unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable because revenue and cost periods do not align. AI-cost records also conflict: $881.36 across 4,832 calls for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27 versus retained $973.35 across 5,439 calls. Infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, approved-budget, experiment-cost, and defined learning-outcome records are absent or incomplete. Continue only existing period-aligned attribution and cost reconciliation; retain the three SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog and do not treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, ordered items, performance scores, or AI usage as financial returns.
